text.p: Cabletron Systems said on Tuesday that it has cancelled a November 5 press conference where it planned to make a SPECTRUM announcement.
The announcement involved a marketing venture with a partner and could be made at a later date, said company spokeswoman Betsey Winckler.
"We were working with a partner and we couldn't work out the details," Winckler said. "We don't have enough of the details hammered out yet."
Cabletron stock fell 2-1/8 to 58 on Tuesday afternoon.
Winckler said the company still plans to make a separate marketplace announcement concerning SPECTRUM, an enterprise platform that manages office computer networks.
